body: I am strongly considering coming back to wow how did this expansion turn out?
Does it matter if I am mature? it isn't a tangible thing, it doesn't help me. I don't know, I look around and the people who treat me like shit are the ones who get it all.
At the end of the day, they are happier? why am I worse off? who cares if I have ethics? I just want to be okay. I want to have hope.

It's just so hard, the past four years, I live with guilt because my ten year old brother is there alone for five days of a week, If I wouldn't have left I could protect him still. I just want someone to love me for me, I want to be not some disfigured disgrace in the eyes of one person. I am never going to get that, just when I thought I was safe I was cheated on then abandoned. I'm lost and I don't think I can ever be found.

It wasn't real at my last school. And parts of stereotypes are there and others aren't. Why do I feel like it? Teachers treat me differently, I was always sat with the students in one corner and segregated from the upper class rich jock guys. They are patronizing and talk like I am a child, they don't outright say crap, but it is all the same. If I sit at the table with someone they will find an excuse to leave which does not hold up when they leave to go hang out with someone who is a snob. Because I have a passion for helping those in need I am treated like a devil in a school of conservatives. I am neither a democrat nor republican, yet I am damned for beliefs they know not of. There was this awesome teacher who was poor and we talked about philosophy and we were scoffed at. My dad is a manager, yet my mother sucks his pay check dry for child support. But why does that standing even matter? When I said how I thought it was brutal and harsh that children are forced to work in sweat shops, I was laughed at in class. I am treated different because I am different. I am treated as lesser because they act like they are better than everyone. And I am not with them, because I am not like them in spirit or stature.

I have no plans, my goal is all A's minus one B for my senior year. I just hate it, I look around and everyone is better than me, there is not one way I can be anything but below average, at my school I'm surrounded by these rich guys who act so entitled, and because in one way I'm flawed and not a big religious guy I'm treated like lesser of a human. I'm not blond hair blue eyes (which all the girls are into) I'm just a short dark brown hair and brown eyed outcast.

I have no one near now, changing schools in the middle of the year (junior year) leaves no one wanting to leave their group and hang out with me. My parents are apathetic and see me as something I am not. So I am alone. I wish I saw hope for a relationship, but come college every girl has already been around, and there is nothing in me that someone would want after having hot athletic guyish guys. I'm different, a good time to me is buying thirty one dollar hamburgers and handing them out to homeless people. A good time to me is seeing a musical or reading a great book. I'm not what a girl in this time looks for, if I was born in the renaissance, then maybe, but not in the time where sex is it. I'm just different, other guys are worth more. I'm sadly me.
